 Kyle Richards’ daughter Farrah gives birth to first baby after ‘RHOBH’ star made frantic dash to the hospital mid-event 
 By 
 Lanae Brody , 
 Riley Cardoza and 
 Samantha Nungesser 
 Published 
 Nov. 17, 2026, 10:16 a.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Kyle Richards is a grandma!
 The “Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” star’s eldest daughter , Farrah Aldjufrie, has given birth to her first child, a baby boy, a source confirmed to Page Six.
 While the “Buying Beverly Hills” alum has yet to officially announce the arrival of her son, her mom spoke to us on the red carpet at the Maison D’Or cocktail launch in Los Angeles Saturday night, sharing her excitement about becoming a grandmother.
 “I’m on baby watch right now,” Richards gushed. “I can’t believe [I’m gonna be a grandma]. I hope it’s not tonight, because am I gonna go to the hospital like this?”
 8 
 Farrah Aldjufrie and Zach Goldsmith have welcomed their first child together. farrahbritt/Instagram 
 8 
 Aldjufrie gave birth to Kyle Richards’ first grandbaby. farrahbritt/Instagram 
 A Page Six spy then spotted Richards excitedly saying goodbye to her “RHOBH” co-stars about an hour into the event, which was being filmed for the show’s next season, before rushing to the elevator in a hurry.
 Our source overheard someone ask Richards if her daughter was in labor and she replied, “I think so!”
 Richards’ older sister, Kathy Hilton, also told us on the carpet that she was late to the party because she was on the phone with the hospital.
 “I’ve been calling to make sure this is not a false alarm because I’m gonna call the hospital to make sure that she gets right in and has a room because, you know, we’re very close to the hospital,” Hilton told us.

 Aldjufrie welcomed the little one with her boyfriend — and former co-star — Zach Goldsmith .
 The infant is the couple’s first child together and Goldsmith’s third.
 He, notably, welcomed two sons, Adler and Miles, with ex-wife Jennifer Hamilton-Goldsmith before they called it quits.
 It is unclear when the former couple split and Goldsmith moved on with Aldjufrie.
 The pair had yet to go public with their romance when Aldjufrie told her Instagram followers she was pregnant in July.

 “My most exciting launch yet. Coming soon,” she captioned her baby bump debut at the time, teasing the baby’s “late November 2026” due date.
 The following month, Aldjufrie name-dropped Goldsmith as her partner via TikTok.
 She posted an August TikTok video of the duo finding out — with the help of a blue flower basket — that they were expecting a son.
 8 
 She identified Goldsmith in her August sex reveal. Farrah Brittany/Tiktok 
 8 
 The pair are expecting a son — and Goldsmith has two other sons (pictured above in 2025) from his previous marriage. zachgoldsmith/Instagram 
 Goldsmith went on to defend himself against haters dubbing him a “married man,” writing, “Talking out of your ass when you have ZERO clue, losing any and all credibility. Couldn’t be more wrong. I’m guessing that’s a common theme in your life.”
 Eagle-eyed Bravo fans retroactively realized the luxury real estate agent’s ex had “liked” Hamilton’s pregnancy reveal — and left a gushing comment .
 “Happy for you, @farrahbritt :),” she wrote at the time.
 8 
 Page Six confirmed in September that Goldsmith (pictured above in 2025) and Aldjufrie were officially “together” and “happy.” zachgoldsmith/Instagram 
 8 
 Her sister Alexia Umansky (pictured above in September) gushed to us that their family “adore[s]” the luxury real estate agent. Page Six 
 Aldjufrie replied, “Thank you so much, Jen. [That] means a lot 🤍🤍🤍.”
 Her sister Alexia Umansky confirmed to Page Six in September that Aldjufrie and Goldsmith are officially “together” and “happy.” 
 The 30-year-old told us, “I adore Zach. I’ve always loved Zach from the very moment I met him. He makes me laugh, and he’s a bright light in every room. It’s going to so amazing to have him be an official part of our family.”
